name: foreman
description: Project continuity for Codex: maintain a correctable roadmap, choose useful work, and craft grounded handoffs with verifiable completion evidence.

interface.shortDescription: A roadmap that stays grounded in your code
interface.longDescription: Keep your plan beside the code, reconcile stale work, and turn tasks into checked Codex prompts. Preserve commit evidence, acceptance, and optional lessons across sessions.
defaultPrompt: Use Foreman to find the next useful task.
Check my roadmap against the code.
Craft a Codex prompt for this task.
